name: GetDashboardComponentData
description: Reads the live metric value for a single BI dashboard component (tile), merging its EVA-side configuration with a call to the BI API.
auth_description: Requires a user of type `Employee` or `Api`

headers.name: EVA-User-Agent
headers.description: The user agent that is making these calls. Don't make this specific per device/browser but per application. This should be of the form: `MyFirstUserAgent/1.0.0`

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnitID
headers.description: The ID of the organization unit to run this request in.

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnit-Query
headers.description: The query that selects the organization unit to run this request in.

headers.name: EVA-IDs-Mode
headers.description: The IDs mode to run this request in. Currently only `ExternalIDs` is supported.

request_samples.name: CURL
request_samples.sample:
curl -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "EVA-User-Agent: MyFirstUserAgent/1.0.0" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  --data '{
  "ComponentID": 123,
  "DivisionPerEmployee": true,
  "OrganizationUnitID": 123,
  "SkipCache": true,
  "TimeFrame": 2
}' \
  https://euw.acme.test.eva-online.cloud/message/GetDashboardComponentData

B.name: ComponentID
B.description: This is the ID of a `BIDashboardComponent`

B.name: DivisionPerEmployee
B.description: Request all employees' data instead of only the caller's own. Requires the BIDashboardViewAllEmployeeData functionality. Accepted and permission-checked, but currently has no effect on the BI API call: the BI API's contract has no field for it yet (OPTR-48410 code review finding R2, decision: keep the flag, ship it inert, revisit once the BI API supports it).

B.name: OrganizationUnitID
B.description:
The organization unit to read BI dashboard data for. Requires the BIDashboardViewData functionality in this organization unit.

This is the ID of a `OrganizationUnit`

B.name: SkipCache
B.description: Bypass the cache for this read. Requires the BIDashboardBypassCache functionality. Accepted and permission-checked, but currently has no effect on the BI API call: the BI API's contract has no field for it yet (OPTR-48410 code review finding R2, decision: keep the flag, ship it inert, revisit once the BI API supports it).

D.name: Code
D.description: A unique ID identifying this error.

D.name: Message
D.description: A human-readable message describing the error.

D.name: RequestID
D.description: A unique ID identifying the request. Please provide this ID when contacting support.

D.name: Type
D.description: A short description of the error type.

E.name: ExternalIDs
E.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the resolved external IDs.

E.name: IsAsyncResultAvailable
E.description: This is a flag indicating whether the async request is done. If it is `null`, it is not an async service. If it is `false`, the response is not yet available. Do not process the properties in that case. It is is `true` the properties are filled with the result of the call.

E.name: UnresolvedExternalIDs
E.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the external IDs we couldn't resolve.

C.name: ComponentType
C.description:
Possible values:

* `1` - ConsumersOnboarded
* `2` - Revenue
* `3` - AverageOrderValue
* `4` - AverageProductsPerBasket
* `5` - TotalTransactions
* `6` - MobileSalesPercentage
* `7` - HeroProducts
* `8` - OverdueTasks
* `9` - SFSExecutionTime
* `10` - IdentifiedSales
* `11` - Custom

C.name: Status
C.description:
Possible values:

* `0` - Ok
* `1` - Materializing
* `2` - SpecInvalid
* `3` - Unsupported

C.name: VisualizationType
C.description:
Possible values:

* `0` - Number
* `1` - Bar
* `2` - LineGraph
* `3` - Pie
* `4` - Gauge
* `5` - KPI
